---
title: "Tuning of the logistic (non-linear) DGM, unanchored"
format: html
editor: visual
---

Parameters of the non-linear DGM for the unanchored branch (with disease duration). The outcome model is the one defined in `without_duration/dgm/logistic/shape_logistic.qmd` (same shape, same bounds), with the treatment acting on the time since trial entry:

$$
\eta_{ij} = a_0 + u_{0i} + \beta_{aoo}\,(aoo_i-\overline{aoo}) + \beta_{male}\,(male_i-\overline{male}) + \beta_{yoo}\,yoo^c_i - k\,t_{ij} + \gamma\,trt_{ij}\,t^{trt}_{ij} + \varepsilon_{ij},
\qquad HUI_{ij} = L + (U-L)\,\text{expit}(\eta_{ij})
$$

with $t_{ij}$ the years since onset and $t^{trt}_{ij}$ the years since trial entry. The parameters are chosen so that the populations have the same properties as the linear unanchored branch (`main_analysis/with duration/continuous/dgm/tune.qmd`):

1.  **treatment model**: SMDs of 0.5 for age of onset and sex between treated and historical controls, with the selection rules of the unanchored DGM (treated: onset before the trial date and at least 9 visits after it; controls: never eligible, onset before the trial date, at least 5 visits before it); the treatment model does not depend on the HUI, so these values match the linear branch;
2.  **drift**: year of onset changes the HUI by about 0.005 per year;
3.  **confounding**: the difference in untreated HUI between the treated and the controls that are still in follow-up at the treated patient's waiting time $w$, compared 2 years later (at $w+2$ years since onset), due to age of onset and sex, is $-0.02$, half from each covariate;
4.  **treatment effects**: the true effect on the HUI scale 2 years after trial entry among the treated (treated minus untreated HUI of the same patients) is 0, 0.05, 0.15 and 0.30.

Treated patients enter the trial at different disease durations, so they are at different points of the curve: the same $\gamma$ gives different effects on the HUI scale, and the true effect is computed over the actual distribution of waiting times.

# Libraries

```{r}
pacman::p_load(dplyr,lubridate)
```

# Settings

```{r}
source("C:\\Users\\P095206\\OneDrive - Amsterdam UMC\\Shared material with Elia\\PhD\\Project 5 - Simulation study in SATs\\Code\\paper\\R\\functions\\wrapper\\continuous\\with duration\\rtruncexp.R")
# shape, as in shape_logistic.qmd
expit=function(x) 1/(1+exp(-x)); logit=function(p) log(p/(1-p))
L=-0.36; U=1
hui=function(eta) L+(U-L)*expit(eta)
eta_of=function(h) logit((h-L)/(U-L))
hui_onset=0.85; hui_ref=0; t_ref=5
a0=eta_of(hui_onset)
k=(eta_of(hui_onset)-eta_of(hui_ref))/t_ref
sd_u0=0.5; sd_eps=0.3
# targets, as in the linear unanchored branch
target_smd_age=0.5; target_smd_sex=0.5; t_int=0
target_bias=-0.20*0.10; share_age=0.5
drift_hui=0.005
targets=c(0,0.025,0.075,0.15)*2     # true effects 2 years after entry: 0, 0.05, 0.15, 0.30
landmark=2
# selection rules of the unanchored DGM
min_vis=9; min_pre=5
trialdate=as.Date("2021-05-31")
n=4e5
```

# Population

Patients with the covariates of the main DGM, the random intercept and the measurement error at the landmark, and the visit schedule of the DGM (every 6 months for 10 years, up to 90 days of delay), which determines who can be treated, the waiting time of the treated and the follow-up of the controls before the trial date.

```{r}
set.seed(3111963)
end_date=as.Date("2022-12-31")
pop=tibble(dateonset=end_date-floor(rtruncexp(n=n,rate=0.0002,max=as.numeric(end_date-as.Date("2005-01-01")))),
           aoo=runif(n,0,8),
           male=as.integer(runif(n)<0.5),
           u=runif(n),
           u0=rnorm(n,0,sd_u0),
           eps=rnorm(n,0,sd_eps)) %>%
  mutate(yoo=year(dateonset),
         yoo_c=yoo-mean(yoo),
         post=dateonset>=trialdate)
# visit schedule
tt=seq(0,365.25*10,by=182.625); jitter=90
set.seed(22101957)
nvis_post=integer(n); npre=integer(n); first_post=rep(NA_real_,n); lastdur=rep(NA_real_,n)
for (j in seq_along(tt)){
  dj=as.numeric(pop$dateonset)+tt[j]+(if (j==1) 0 else runif(n,0,jitter))
  pre_j=dj<as.numeric(trialdate)
  nvis_post=nvis_post+!pre_j
  npre=npre+pre_j
  first_post=ifelse(is.na(first_post) & !pre_j,dj,first_post)
  lastdur=ifelse(pre_j,dj-as.numeric(pop$dateonset),lastdur)
}
pop=pop %>% mutate(nvis_post=nvis_post,                              # visits on/after the trial date
                   npre=npre,                                        # visits before the trial date
                   wait=(first_post-as.numeric(dateonset))/365.25,   # years from onset to trial entry
                   lastdur=lastdur/365.25)                           # years from onset to the last visit before the trial date
rm(dj,pre_j,first_post,nvis_post,npre,lastdur)
aoo_mean=mean(pop$aoo); male_mean=mean(pop$male)
smd_abs=function(x,g) abs((mean(x[g==1])-mean(x[g==0]))/sqrt((var(x[g==1])+var(x[g==0]))/2))
```

# 1. Treatment model: SMDs

```{r}
select_trt=function(d,t_age,t_sex){
  d %>% mutate(conf=u<plogis(t_int-t_age*aoo+t_sex*male),
               trt_overall=conf & nvis_post>=1,                 # would have received the treatment
               trt=as.integer(conf & nvis_post>=min_vis & !post),
               duration=ifelse(trt==1,wait,lastdur)) %>%
    filter(trt==1 | (!trt_overall & !post & npre>=min_pre))
}
obj=function(par){
  d=select_trt(pop,par[1],par[2])
  (smd_abs(d$aoo,d$trt)-target_smd_age)^2+(smd_abs(d$male,d$trt)-target_smd_sex)^2
}
o=optim(c(0.3,1.3),obj,method="Nelder-Mead",control=list(reltol=1e-10))
t_age=o$par[1]; t_sex=o$par[2]
d=select_trt(pop,t_age,t_sex)
tr=d %>% filter(trt==1); ct=d %>% filter(trt==0) %>% arrange(duration)
c(t_int=t_int,t_age=t_age,t_sex=t_sex,smd_age=smd_abs(d$aoo,d$trt),smd_sex=smd_abs(d$male,d$trt),
  treated=nrow(tr),controls=nrow(ct))
summary(tr$wait)          # waiting times of the treated (years)
```

# Latent scale at a given time since onset

```{r}
eta_at=function(x,tau,b_aoo,b_male,b_yoo,gamma=0,t_trt=0){
  a0+x$u0+b_aoo*(x$aoo-aoo_mean)+b_male*(x$male-male_mean)+b_yoo*x$yoo_c-k*tau+gamma*t_trt+x$eps
}
slope=function(eta) (U-L)*expit(eta)*(1-expit(eta))
```

# 2. Drift

Latent effect of year of onset that changes the HUI by about `drift_hui` per year, on average over the treated 2 years after entry.

```{r}
b_yoo=drift_hui/mean(slope(eta_at(tr,tr$wait+landmark,0,0,0)))
b_yoo
```

# 3. Confounding: covariate effects

As in the linear tuning, a treated patient with waiting time $w$ is compared with the controls still in follow-up at $w$ (duration $>w$), all of them equally likely; age of onset and sex each account for half of the latent difference ($\beta_{aoo}\,\Delta_{aoo}=\beta_{male}\,\Delta_{male}=s/2$, with $\Delta$ the treated minus duration-matched controls difference). $s$ is found so that the difference in untreated HUI at $w+2$ years since onset due to these covariates (drift excluded) equals `target_bias`. Waiting times are grouped in steps of 0.05 years for the controls.

```{r}
# expected covariate differences after duration matching (as matched_diffs in the linear tuning)
suf=function(x) c(rev(cumsum(rev(x))),0)
idx=findInterval(tr$wait,ct$duration); n_el=nrow(ct)-idx; ok=n_el>0
diff_aoo=mean(tr$aoo[ok])-mean(suf(ct$aoo)[idx[ok]+1]/n_el[ok])
diff_male=mean(tr$male[ok])-mean(suf(ct$male)[idx[ok]+1]/n_el[ok])
c(diff_aoo=diff_aoo,diff_male=diff_male,treated_without_eligible_control=sum(!ok))
coefs=function(s) c(b_aoo=share_age*s/diff_aoo,b_male=(1-share_age)*s/diff_male)
w_bin=round(tr$wait/0.05)*0.05; bins=sort(unique(w_bin[ok]))
bias_hui=function(s){
  b=coefs(s)
  h_t=hui(eta_at(tr,tr$wait+landmark,b["b_aoo"],b["b_male"],0))
  # controls still in follow-up at w, compared at w + landmark
  h_c=sapply(bins,function(w){
    e=ct$duration>w
    mean(hui(eta_at(ct[e,],w+landmark,b["b_aoo"],b["b_male"],0)))
  })
  h_c_tr=h_c[match(w_bin,bins)]
  use=ok & !is.na(h_c_tr)
  mean(h_t[use])-mean(h_c_tr[use])
}
s=uniroot(function(s) bias_hui(s)-target_bias,c(-3,3),tol=1e-8)$root
b=coefs(s)
c(s=s,b,bias=bias_hui(s))
```

# 4. Treatment effects

True effect 2 years after trial entry among the treated: mean of the treated minus the untreated HUI of the same patients at $w+2$ years since onset ($t^{trt}=2$). $\gamma$ is found for every target; the largest possible effect on a bounded scale ($\gamma\to\infty$) is shown as a check.

```{r}
eta_t=eta_at(tr,tr$wait+landmark,b["b_aoo"],b["b_male"],b_yoo)
h0=hui(eta_t)
effect=function(gamma) mean(hui(eta_t+gamma*landmark)-h0)
max_effect=mean(U-h0)
gammas=sapply(targets,function(target) if (target==0) 0 else uniroot(function(g) effect(g)-target,c(0,20),tol=1e-10)$root)
tibble(true_effect=targets,gamma=gammas,delta=gammas/k,check=sapply(gammas,effect))
c(mean_untreated_hui_treated_2y_after_entry=mean(h0),max_possible_effect=max_effect)
```

# Parameters for the non-linear DGM

To copy into `effect_size_loop_logistic.qmd` of this branch.

```{r}
params=c(a0=a0,k=k,sd_u0=sd_u0,sd_eps=sd_eps,
         t_int=t_int,t_age=t_age,t_sex=t_sex,
         b_aoo=unname(b["b_aoo"]),b_male=unname(b["b_male"]),b_yoo=b_yoo,
         setNames(gammas,paste0("gamma_",targets)))
round(params,4)
cat(paste0("aoo_mean=",round(aoo_mean,4),"; male_mean=",round(male_mean,4)," # centring values used for the covariates\n"))
```
